dialogues.speaker: <UNKNOWN>
dialogues.text: The Tatarigami has been causing trouble all over this island recently, and the Sangonomiya rebels have also invaded.

dialogues.speaker: <UNKNOWN>
dialogues.text: Miners, family members, and all other personnel, please evacuate the island in an orderly manner as soon as possible!

dialogues.speaker: <UNKNOWN>
dialogues.text: Your life is at stake. This is an affair of utmost urgency!

dialogues.speaker: <UNKNOWN>
dialogues.text: Residents, please do not panic. The Tenryou Commissioner, Lord Kujou Takayuki, feels the pain of the refugees on Yashiori Island, and has come to your rescue.

dialogues.speaker: <UNKNOWN>
dialogues.text: If you need help, please come to the Kujou troops' forward operating base.

dialogues.speaker: <UNKNOWN>
dialogues.text: The Tenryou Commission will ensure that you are escorted off the island safely.
